metadata.selection: Purposive feasibility cohort chosen for publicly disclosed links and readable source documents; not a representative market universe.
metadata.event_policy: All four scheduled result releases during calendar2025 for each of WMT, HD, LOW and DE, irrespective of guidance change. Known interim statements retained separately.
metadata.entry_clock_policy: All events have date-only verified availability; next regular US trading-session entry must be selected by an exchange calendar, not a calendar-day increment.
metadata.relationships_policy: Fixed pre-2025 named-customer graph. Percentages are historical annual concentration. No present-day relationship backfill.
metadata.acquisition_scope_flag_definition: True means acquisition effects are included in the disclosed forecast perimeter; it does not imply the perimeter changed at this event. Use each guide change_status for changes.

other_prior_context.notes: Original release describes2025 scenario planning; numerical investor presentation not audited. Do not silently call this a forecast initialization or revised FY2024 guide.

completeness.guidance_fields: Selected annual revenue/sales/segment-sales/comparable-sales fields extracted; not all metrics in each document.

HD.limitations: Conferences and acquisition announcements can contain information outside quarterly releases; their full presentations/audio were not audited.

LOW.limitations: Financial-release archive located all four scheduled releases; unscheduled conference content not fully inspected.

screened_other_families.reason: Existing release-only source route supplies quarterly actuals but has not established a comparable same-period forward numeric guide history; call commentary requires a separate timestamp/version audit.

December3,2025 revised delivery target around820 toaround790 following supplier fuselage-panel quality issue. This is an aircraft-count/supply constraint, not interchangeable with revenue-demand guidance. Existing SPR edge also has known pending takeover.
Different units and first-public monthly operating disclosures require a distinct ledger; existing SPR target has known takeover confounding. No full-year no-event claim made.

research_limits: Annual guidance change includes realized-quarter information. Without matched old quarterly expectation on the same additive basis it is not a clean remaining-year revision.
Unchanged annual guidance can still convey new information; zero guide delta does not mean zero news.
Do not subtract percentages across annual and quarterly periods or conflate net sales, total revenue, constant-currency and reported dollars.
Approximate and qualitative guides must remain flagged. Do not fabricate exact values for slightly positive.
Multiple suppliers exposed to one customer release are clustered outcomes, not independent source shocks. HD and LOW commonly report on adjacent days.
Seven suppliers and16source reports are a data audit, not adequate proof of return predictability or a high-frequency opportunity count.
A named historical customer link does not establish a leading signal: suppliers may already have disclosed the same demand or have direct order visibility.
This fixed graph intentionally tests a disclosed cohort; it does not estimate all suppliers or adjust graph weights using future reports.
Known supplier POS disclosures and guidance withdrawals must enter the pre-source information ledger; a source event need not lead supplier-investor information.

supplier_information_examples.summary: Issuer clarifies that double-digit first-half growth discussed on CNBC referred to retailer POS units, not company sales. This predates HD May20 and LOW May21.
supplier_information_examples.limitation: Primary filing proves the clarification and reports the earlier appearance; original TV clip/time not independently audited.

supplier_information_examples.summary: Supplier reported consumer POS units up12% through first half, measured using its largest retailers, while reaffirming full-year USConsumer sales guidance.
supplier_information_examples.limitation: This is a supplier-investor information baseline, not evidence that later customer guidance is uninformative.

supplier_information_examples.summary: Supplier declined to provide full-year2025 financial guidance due to tariff and macro uncertainty, before HD/LOW May releases.
supplier_information_examples.limitation: Cannot use a stale withdrawn supplier guide as an active baseline.

sources_only_diagnostic.mapping: WMT same-FY constant-currency net-sales midpoint delta; HD/LOW same-FY comparable-sales midpoint delta; DE3segment midpoint deltas positive if at least1up and none down, negative conversely, mixed/unknown abstain. Initializations abstain.
sources_only_diagnostic.calendar_overlap_cluster_definition: Connected components of next-US-session-open to fifth-session-close inclusive windows, allowing a shared entry/exit date to overlap. These are operational overlap groups, not certified statistically independent observations.
sources_only_diagnostic.calendar_scope: Only dates needed for these2025 windows. Closures affecting them:Feb17,May26,Nov27. Nov28 early close counts as a session. No general calendar implementation is claimed.
